Cardcaptor Sakura - Sakura to Fushigi na.name: Card Captor Sakura: Sakura to Fushigi na Clow Card
Cardcaptor Sakura - Sakura to Fushigi na.summary: Card Captor Sakura: Sakura to Fushigi na Clow Card is a Role-Playing game, developed by Sims and published by Bandai, which was released in Japan in 1999.

Digimon Adventure 02 - Tag Tamers.name: Digimon Adventure 02: Tag Tamers
Digimon Adventure 02 - Tag Tamers.summary: Digimon Adventure 02: Tag Tamers is a role-playing video game by Bandai, for the WonderSwan. It was released in Japan on 3 August 2000. The game is based on the manga series Digimon, in which children can travel to a digital world and help good digital monsters to defeat evil ones.
